title: Deck
description: Slide decks: seventeen layouts, six templates, whole designs and brand kits imported from Brandkits, slides arranged as in PowerPoint (drag, multi-select, cut, copy and paste, a slide sorter, undo), a presenter view, and exports to one HTML file and to PowerPoint with editable slides and speaker notes. The person's own agent writes a deck, reworks a slide as variants, or runs a mission.
